title: The Playlist of Westbrook High
author: Elodie Nystrom
blurb: Tamsin Villalobos, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must expose what the school board buried before the last game of the season.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
